name: Median probability model
model_likelihood: Normal linear regression and its variable-subset models; n responses and a full-rank n by k design with k < n.
prior: No unique prior is required; one admissible family uses conjugate normal coefficient priors with diagonal Lambda and matching submodel priors.
inference_algorithm: Given posterior model probabilities, sum over models containing each variable; MCMC inclusion frequencies provide an implementation of this posterior calculation.
estimand: The submodel containing every variable with marginal posterior inclusion probability >= 0.5, if that submodel exists.
data_input: Model posterior probabilities and within-model parameter posterior distributions obtained from response data, design and priors.
tunable_settings: Candidate model class; model prior probabilities; coefficient-prior mean mu and covariance multiplier Lambda; variance prior or given variance. The 0.5 cutoff defines the method.
